Generated Narrative: CodeSystem observation-status-reason

This case-sensitive code system http://hl7.org/fhir/CodeSystem/observation-status-reason defines the following codes:

Code Display Definition
patient-mismatch Patient Mismatch The patient identity or subject context did not match the expected patient or subject.
sample-mismatch Sample Mismatch The specimen, sample, or referenced result did not match the expected subject, order, container, or report.
invalid-calibration Invalid Calibration The device, instrument, or analyzer calibration used for referenced results was invalid, expired, or otherwise unreliable.
reagent-issue Reagent issue An incorrect, invalid, expired, recalled, or otherwise unsuitable reagent or reagent lot was used or identified for referenced results.
duplicate Duplicate The observation duplicates another observation.

name: ObservationStatusReasonCodes
title: Observation Status Reason Codes
description: Codes indicating why an observation is in its current status.
